items.shadow_impact: An attacker can make a potential profit by repeated buys followed by a single sell exploiting differing rounding effects.
items.reason: Claim exists but has no P/I/V formulas (expression null); effect_coverage marks attacker_profit unformalized. Honest bookkeeping but not completed coverage.

items.shadow_impact: The protocol can be frozen for a specific token when few quoteReserves remain, because quoteBoughtByCurve reverts if quoteReserve < VIRTUAL_QUOTE.
items.reason: Both claims formalize the revert condition and blocked sell; last_seller_blocked V expresses reserve<V and not sell_completed, matching the report's freeze claim.

items.shadow_impact: Users can take more quote tokens out of the protocol than they put in due to the rounding issue, which can push quoteReserve below VIRTUAL_QUOTE.
items.reason: This mechanism (rounding lets users extract more quote than deposited, driving reserve below VIRTUAL_QUOTE) has no dedicated coverage row or claim; it is only referenced as a precondition, not formalized as a harm.

items.shadow_impact: If all holders attempt to sell, the last seller may be unable to sell due to the revert.
items.reason: Claim V conjoins reserve<V with not sell_completed, capturing the last seller being blocked by the revert.

omissions_or_errors: The mechanism 'users can take more quote tokens out than they put in due to rounding' is not given its own coverage row or claim; it is only used as a precondition.
